notes: The NAP pages (nationalacademies.org/read/12190 and /chapter/2) loaded but showed only citation details (NRC 2009, NAP, DOI 10.17226/12190), not the Strand 6 text. cite_as: NAAEE (2019). K-12 Environmental Education: Guidelines for Excellence. North American Association for Environmental Education.
claimed_component: The full K-12 guidelines document (not only its executive summary) contains a guideline or learner outcome on connection to nature (for example, feeling connected to, caring about, or valuing the natural world).
excerpt: Identify, clarify, and express their beliefs and values regarding the environment
notes: The full NAAEE PDF ('Copyright © 2019 by the North American Association for Environmental Education') exists, and the attribution is correct. But the K–4 and 5–8 guidelines I could read have no explicit learner outcome on connection to nature. The closest are this values outcome (K–4, 3.2A) and an underpinning, 'learners connect with, explore, and understand their immediate surroundings.' The 9–12 section did not come through in the extracted text, so it is unchecked. Treat this as a loose fit at best.
